title: HV-CTAB-PCI DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Vicky Ooi
materials: Lysis Buffer 1 (LB1: CTAB 2 %, Tris– HCL 100 mM, EDTA 20 mM, NaCl 1 M)
Lysis Buffer 2 (LB2: CTAB 10 %, NaCl 0.5 M, pH 5.5)

steps.title: Disinfect workbench
steps.instruction: Clean the working bench with TriGene disinfectant.

steps.title: Collect 1 g fecal sample
steps.instruction: Scrape 1 g of fecal material from the outer surface of a feces and place it into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Grind feces with liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Transfer the fecal material into a mortar, add liquid nitrogen, and grind the feces into a fine powder.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer 1 (first aliquot)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of Lysis Buffer 1 (CTAB 2 %, Tris‑HCl 100 mM, EDTA 20 mM, NaCl 1.4 M, pH 7.5) to the mortar, continue grinding and mixing, then transfer the liquid back into the 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Complete LB1 addition
steps.instruction: Add a second 1 mL of LB1 to the mortar, mix and transfer; repeat this step once more, then add 2 mL of LB1 directly to the 15 mL tube, for a total of 5 mL LB1 in the homogenate.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate for lysis
steps.instruction: Vortex the faecal homogenate, then incubate in a thermomixer at 60 °C for 3 h with occasional mixing.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 3,150 g (4,000 rpm) for 12 min; pipette 4 mL of the supernatant into a new 15 mL tube.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (21:20:1) to the supernatant, gently mix, centrifuge at 3,150 g (4,000 rpm) for 3 min, and transfer 3 mL of the aqueous phase to a new 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer 2 and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 330 µL of Lysis Buffer 2 (CTAB 10 %, NaCl 0.5 M, pH 5.5) to the aqueous phase and incubate at 60 °C for 4 h.

steps.title: Protease digestion
steps.instruction: Add 104 µL of protease to the mixture and incubate at 60 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 3 434 µL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (21:20:1), mix gently, centrifuge at 3,150 g (4,000 rpm) for 12 min, and transfer 3 mL of the aqueous phase to a new 15 mL tube.

steps.title: DNA precipitation with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add one volume (3 mL) of isopropanol to the aqueous phase, mix, and incubate overnight at –20 °C.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 8,000 g (5,200 rpm) for 20 min, then discard all supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of 70 % ethanol to the pellet, vortex, centrifuge at 3,150 g for 12 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet in a fume hood at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 250 µL of TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8).

steps.title: Store DNA isolate
steps.instruction: Store the DNA isolate at –20 °C for use within a week or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.
